description: On 2026-07-30 the public site at cityscroll.org served ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS while the deploy pipeline reported success. A GitHub Pages CNAME / domain-cutover misconfiguration produced a 301 loop between cityscroll.org and crol-list.org that Fastly absorbed then exposed. The post-deploy live-URL smoke gate did not exist; this fixture pins that failure shape so the gate cannot regress to a silent green deploy.
